goals.title: Vätternrundan 2027
goals.direction: Finish strongly; performance ambition about 28 km/h average and ~180 W average, recognizing wind, drafting and group dynamics.

goals.title: Lose approximately 10 kg before Vätternrundan
goals.direction: Use weekly weight trend and preserve cycling power, strength and recovery.

rules: Use an adaptive daily coaching model instead of fixed cycling/strength weekdays.
Prioritize one long-endurance cycling session every week whenever practical.
Do not create missed-session debt when family/life changes the week.
Indoor fan is non-negotiable for Zwift quality work.
Treat indoor and outdoor power as different measurement systems.
strategy:
Current phase: post-Møn off-season strength-and-power development.

Primary direction:
- Become a materially stronger cyclist by increasing sustainable power.
- Improve aerobic efficiency at useful endurance/tempo outputs.
- Improve durability so useful power can be maintained late in long rides.
- Preserve endurance while strength and power develop.
- Do not make preparation FTP-only.
- Gradually increase total saddle time toward Vätternrundan-specific durability.
